description: This PHP class 'LeaveBalance' represents an entity in the Leave module of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages leave entitlement, usage, scheduling, pending, taken leave, and balance calculations, including date handling and configuration integration.

classes.name: LeaveBalance
classes.description: A class encapsulating leave entitlement information, including methods to calculate and retrieve leave balances, manage associated dates, and integrate with leave configuration settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LeaveBalance with optional leave entitlement values and updates the balance.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Calculates and updates the leave balance considering entitlement, scheduled, taken, and pending leaves, optionally including pending in the calculation based on config.

methods.name: getAsAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date as of which the leave data is relevant.

methods.name: getYmdAsAtDate
methods.description: Returns the 'YYYY-MM-DD' formatted string of the 'as at' date.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for the leave balance calculation.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the 'YYYY-MM-DD' formatted string of the end date.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the leave balance calculation.
